summary_md:
Today’s batch leans heavily into turnarounds and strategic pivots, with insider buying and AI-linked infrastructure bids surfacing as recurring threads. The most distinctive narratives come from DGXX, where an on-schedule AI data center buildout is already generating GPU-as-a-Service revenue and pointing to a sharp inflection; STRS, whose Bitcoin-tied preferred shares have plunged, forcing management to make restoring that capital vehicle its immediate priority; and BEEP, where an operational inflection in its parking portfolio is compressing short interest and attracting institutional buyers. Elsewhere, JCTC’s radical product overhaul and large insider purchases signal credible restructuring, while UFI benefits from a potential onshoring tailwind as tariffs threaten Bangladeshi apparel.

The batch also includes two AI-infrastructure plays—DGXX’s concrete execution and IMSR’s aspirational nuclear SMR—plus a cluster of insider confidence signals across HNRG, OPAL, and JCTC.
